# PK/KEK/DB keys generated by following commands

```
$ GUID=$(uuidgen)
$ openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout PK.key -new -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -subj "/CN=Noob Platform Key/" -out PK.crt
$ cert-to-efi-sig-list -g "${GUID}" PK.crt PK.esl
$ openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout KEK.key -new -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -subj "/CN=Noob Key Exchange Key/" -out KEK.crt
$ cert-to-efi-sig-list -g "${GUID}" KEK.crt KEK.esl
$ openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout db.key -new -x509 -sha256 -days 3650 -subj "/CN=Noob Signature Database key/" -out db.crt
$ cert-to-efi-sig-list -g "${GUID}" db.crt db.esl
```

# Integrate PK/KEK/DB keys to the buildsystem

PK/KEK keys would be built into [UefiDefaultSecurityKeys.dts](recipes-bsp/uefi/tegra-uefi-keys-dtb/UefiDefaultSecurityKeys.dts), it's generated by the following command:

```
$ sudo tmp-glibc/work-shared/L4T-native-36.4.4-r0/Linux_for_Tegra/tools/gen_uefi_keys_dts.sh files/uefi-keys/uefi_keys.conf
```

Set following two variables for DB keys, to sign payloads:

```
TEGRA_UEFI_DB_KEY = "${CUSTOM_COREBASE}/files/uefi-keys/db.key"
TEGRA_UEFI_DB_CERT = "${CUSTOM_COREBASE}/files/uefi-keys/db.crt"
```

# How to verify UEFI payloads signatures

After bitbake build finishes, run the following commands to check UEFI payloads' signatures, for instance, kernel image:

```
$ bitbake sbsigntool-native -c addto_recipe_sysroot
$ oe-run-native sbsigntool-native sbverify --cert ../source/meta-custom-bsp/files/uefi-keys/db.crt --list image/p3509-a02-p3767-0000/Image
signature 1
image signature issuers:
 - /CN=Noob Signature Database key
image signature certificates:
 - subject: /CN=Noob Signature Database key
   issuer:  /CN=Noob Signature Database key
```

# How to verify UEFI secureboot at runtime

Run the following command:

```
$ efivar -n 8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c-SecureBoot
GUID: 8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c
Name: "SecureBoot"
Attributes:
	Boot Service Access
	Runtime Service Access
Value:
00000000  01                                                |.               |
```
